sources.coverage: Original Inventec article dated 2020-11-04, captured 2026-10-04. In the datacenter hardware paragraph, five exact named products are followed by an explicit statement that Inventec EBG developed and manufactured them. This is a dated vendor manufacturer claim; no factory, production duration, customer/operator or unit provenance asserted. The unnamed custom servers, software offerings, Intel C5000X base platform and separately IAC-manufactured 5G V2X OBU Box are excluded; no global subsidiary alias added.
